To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we introduce the AttnGAN, which is an attentional generative adversarial network that can generate high quality images with fine grained details; 2) we introduce a deep attentional similarity model to compute the fine grained image-text matching loss for training AttnGAN; and 3) the AttnGAN is able to automatically attend to the relevant words for generating different parts in an image.

(1) the AttnGAN, with a novel attentional generation mechanism, is able to synthesize fine granded details at different subregions of an image by paying attention to the relevant words of the natural language description; (2) the AttnGan, with a deep attentional image-text matching loss, is able to compute a fine-grained image-text matching score for the training of the generator, significantly boosting the state of the art on the CUB and COCO datasets;
we propose an Attention-based Generative Adverserial Network (Attn-GAN) to generate images from natural language descriptions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the generation of images based on text descriptions, and we propose the AttnGAN to address this problem.
the generation of high-quality images from natural language sentences, which is a very challenging and important problem in computer vision.
the problem of fine grained text-to-image generation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed AttnGAN is a novel and powerful generative framework for fine grained image synthesis from natural language descriptions.
this paper presents a novel attentional GAN architecture, and a deep attentional similarity model for text-image matching, which are both very useful in their own right.

the AttnGAN is the first GAN based text to image generation model that can automatically select the relevant parts of the condition for generating the corresponding parts of the image, and thus is able to achieve a new state of the art on fine grained text image synthesis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an attentional generative adversarial network (AttnGAN), a deep attentional multi-modal similarity model, and a fine grained text-to-image generation framework.
we have proposed the AttnGAN that allows fine grained image generation with the attention mechanism.
we have proposed an attentional GAN that allows multi stage refinement for text to image generation with a novel attentional similarity loss for the generator.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the attentional generative model can learn to attend to the relevant words for generating fine grained details.
the layered attention mechanism is able to learn a fine grained text-conditioned image generation process.
the attention mechanism is an effective tool for fine grained image synthesis.
